page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 16 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, paired with 120.0 GB of system memory. The server includes bundled hardware acceleration in the form of two NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPUs, providing a combined 32 GB of VRAM. Local storage is also bundled, consisting of a 944 GB SSD, while network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark data highlights a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core operations. The single-core CPU performance, measured via stress-ng, falls in the bottom 10%, and single-threaded tasks like gzip compression and bzip3 decompression register in the bottom 25%. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by stress-ng multi-core and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression benchmarks. Memory bandwidth remains stable in the middle 50% tier, reaching 683.87 GB/sec for small block reads and 56.56 GB/sec for large block reads. Redis SET operations and static web serving throughput also perform at average levels.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this server offers a dense combination of dedicated legacy CPU cores, local SSD storage, and dual GPUs. While the older Intel Broadwell CPU architecture limits single-threaded efficiency, the bundled 944 GB SSD and dual NVIDIA P100 GPUs make it a viable option for workloads that rely heavily on parallel GPU acceleration rather than raw single-core CPU speed. Appropriate workloads include legacy GPU-accelerated database operations, parallel data processing, machine learning inference, and multi-threaded data decompression tasks.
